text:
Vik: UX note from today's sync: compare table gets visually noisy when multiple performance badges + version pins appear. On narrow screens badges wrap and push the pin icon out of view. Need a short pattern we can implement this sprint.

Tasha: Quick options: 1) force single-line badges with +N overflow, 2) collapse badges into a compact dropdown, 3) reserve a fixed pin column so the pin never moves. My vote: fixed pin column + +N overflow for badges.

Jorge: Accessibility: fixed pin column is best for keyboard predictability. If we do +N overflow, the +N trigger must be keyboard focusable and announce "Shows 3 additional metrics". Also the color for success badges fails at small sizes; use success-600 and add iconography.

Ibrahim: Implementation caveat: our virtualized list unmounts cells aggressively. If the pin control lives inside the row, focus can jump. We should adopt a roving tabindex pattern or render the pin control as a sibling overlay (aligned to rows) to avoid losing focus on rerender. Roving tabindex is lower-friction.

Anya: For microcopy: standardize on "Pin to comparison" everywhere. Tooltip: "Pin this model version so it remains in the current comparison". For the overflow trigger use "View metrics (3)" not just "+3" so it's explicit.

Tasha: Mobile: do we prefer a summary chip that opens a sheet or horizontal scroll for badges? Summary chip -> sheet wins for thumb reach and less accidental horizontal scroll. Sheet header should read: "Performance metrics (3)".

Jorge: A11y detail: the sheet should set focus to the list inside and use aria-modal semantics, and we must debounce live metric updates inside the sheet so screen readers don't get spammed while metrics stream. Polite live region for counts, not assertive.

Ibrahim: For keyboard badge navigation on desktop, let's allow arrow keys when the badge group is focused and implement a visible focus ring per badge. Example note for devs: when badgeGroup receives ArrowRight, focus moves to next badge; if on last, focus goes to +N trigger.

Vik: Also adding a small density toggle in header (Comfortable / Compact). Compact hides descriptions and reduces badge spacing. Add telemetry event compact_mode_toggled. Toggle should be aria-pressed and announce the mode change via aria-live polite.

Anya: I'll update the Figma with: fixed pin column mock, +N overflow popover labeled "View metrics (N)", mobile sheet, and compact toggle text changes. Will include a11y notes about roving tabindex and live region debouncing.

design-bot: Figma frames uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/.../catalog-compare-ux-compact-pin-overflow  comments enabled for @Vik @Tasha @Jorge @Ibrahim.

Vik: Great. Devs can prototype roving tabindex + +N popover. Please post final copy + accessibility nits here by EOD so we can cut the patch.
